title: Local Tip: Use Pune Metro for COEP to Shivajinagar commute
content: For new students at COEP: Avoid taking auto-rickshaws during peak hours (5 PM to 7 PM). The traffic near the bridge is horrible. Pune Metro is fully functional and takes exactly 4 minutes from COEP to Shivajinagar. Tickets are just ₹10!
author: Deepak Mane
